images.description: The live conversation detail shows End when the current capture ID matches and local transcript segments are empty.
The live transcript page opened from Home’s placeholder shows Finish before any local transcript segments arrive.
After End on the live detail, Home shows the Processing row.
Home shows Listening and Processing together. A left swipe leaves the Listening row in place.
End Conversation is available on the next live detail while the previous finish is processing.
Finish is available on the next local capture page opened from the Listening placeholder.
